venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
abstract: Recent advancements in large language models enable strong general reasoning, but existing models lack continuous personalization. This work proposes EvolvingAgent-Zero, a framework that allows small language models to self-evolve based on daily user interactions. The system selectively stores meaningful memory, abstracts behavioral patterns, and periodically performs self-replacement training while preserving identity consistency. abstract: Traditional large language models (LLMs) are scoped to individual user sessions, limiting their knowledge to a single conversation and preventing them from learning user preferences that evolve over time.
